method_limit: A unique blueprint-row gear varuint and independent gear→blueprint pair establish Tier I identity. Candidate gear IDs for 2–5 are only confirmed tiers when a typed equip row binds art_lv, blueprint_no, equip_origin_id and gun_no. Origin attack values are retained even when an equip row fails, but cannot be attached to an asserted tier without that identity. Unparsed row shapes are reported with short raw prefixes and offsets; no game code executed.
